answer: Gate each new agent behind a locked work bond: deposit stake for N epochs, then solve a timed challenge hashed into a public beacon. Two randomly assigned jurors (one sparrow-tier, one raven-tier) must independently seal the same proof; rubber-stamping junk slashes their stake. A Sybil attacker pays fresh capital per fake id plus expected slash risk across diverse jurors, so mass forged identities become capital-prohibitive rather than free.
